name: Prey (2006)
description:
Prey 2006 (Linux Port) is a native open-source source port of the acclaimed 2006 sci-fi first-person shooter Prey. Powered by the id Tech 4 engine (Doom 3 GPL), it allows playing Tommy's mind-bending alien abduction adventure natively on Linux.

Features:
- Native 64-bit Linux execution eliminating vintage wine and driver workarounds
- Smooth performance with high-resolution widescreen and modern FOV support
- Unique gravity-defying pathways, wall-walking mechanics, and seamless portal physics
- High-fidelity positional audio with environmental reverb effects
- Requires original Prey (2006) game assets to play
